/-- Twice a number, written as a sum. -/
def weight (n : Nat) : Nat := n + n

private def shift (n : Nat) : Nat := n + 1

/-- The successor, through a private helper. -/
def next (n : Nat) : Nat := shift n

  fst : Nat
  snd : Nat
